title: Ernakulam District Kudumbashree Mission eyeing return of ₹4 crore from its 250 Onam fairs
description: The stalls set up across the district offer an eclectic blend of products ranging from pickles and snacks to vegetables and flowers. Marketed under the campaign ‘Onam with Kudumbashree’ targets to offer a range of unadulterated and quality products to the public
